source: Arbitrum One archive RPC. state_before: eth_getStorageAt of the quote extension's state word for the pool at block_number - 1; words_before: the pool's extsload of slot 0, slot 1 and every bin word (in that order, bins from lowest_bin up) at block_number - 1; logs: eth_getLogs of the pool for block_number, in log order; state_after and slot0_after: the extension's word and the pool's slot 0 at block_number. config_word and parameters_word are the same at both ends of the sample.
